verdict.rationale: Firebase is a backend-as-a-service platform, not an AI agent/assistant that consumes external tools; the evidence shows Firebase ships an MCP *server* (firebase-docs-12, firebase-docs-20) that other AI tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.) connect to, which is the opposite direction from this story. There is no evidence of Firebase itself acting as an MCP client that plugs in third-party MCP servers to gain their tools, and this role doesn't fit the product's category.
